IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair slicked
back into a low ponytail, with a pale blue satin
ribbon tied around it. She wears a pale blue satin
halter top with a printed pattern and a delicate pearl
necklace. Gold drop earrings and bright blue eyes.
Her expression is calm and composed. A soft blue
backdrop with gentle, even lighting. Palette of
powder blue, gold, and ivory. Polished and
feminine, in the style of a runway beauty close-up.
